macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: US stocks rise as cooler inflation eases Fed hike concerns
items.summary: US stock futures and major indexes moved higher after August PCE inflation slowed to 3.4% year over year from 3.7% in July, while core PCE eased to 3.0% from 3.3%. Dow futures rose about 0.3%, with S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 futures also gaining roughly 0.3%.

items.title: Treasury yields remain near multi-year highs
items.summary: Long-term Treasury yields recently reached levels not seen in decades, with the 30-year yield above 5.6% and the 10-year yield near 5.3%, intensifying pressure on equity valuations and borrowing costs.

items.title: Carnival shares surge after earnings and buyback completion
items.summary: Carnival rose about 13.4% after reporting quarterly results and completing a $1.2 billion share-repurchase program, making it one of the session’s strongest large-company movers.

items.title: Robinhood gains after expanded trading features
items.summary: Robinhood shares rose about 5% premarket after the company announced new trading capabilities and expanded weekend trading hours.

items.title: Micron earnings become key market focus
items.summary: Micron shares edged higher ahead of its results, while investors also watched upcoming earnings from Jabil, Accenture and Nike for signals on technology demand, consulting activity and consumer spending.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin and Ethereum edge higher as crypto market cap nears $3 trillion
items.summary: The global cryptocurrency market capitalization rose about 0.5% to $2.96 trillion over 24 hours. Bitcoin traded near $83,337, up 0.4%, while Ethereum was around $2,673, up 0.5%.[1]

items.title: U.S. lawmakers expand investigation into crypto prediction markets
items.summary: The House Oversight Committee requested records from Hyperliquid Labs, Crypto.com and Aristotle Exchange regarding KYC procedures and suspicious-transaction monitoring. The inquiry follows earlier scrutiny of Kalshi and Polymarket.[1]

items.title: UK FCA begins accepting applications under planned crypto regime
items.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority has started accepting crypto-asset authorization applications ahead of a February 28, 2027 deadline. Existing anti-money-laundering registrations will not automatically convert into FCA authorization.[4]

items.title: Illinois publishes draft rules for digital-asset transaction tax
items.summary: Illinois draft rules address the application of the state’s 0.2% digital-asset transaction tax to stablecoins, DeFi platforms, bridges and self-custody transfers.[4]

items.title: Balancer governance approves orderly shutdown plan
items.summary: Balancer passed a proposal for an orderly shutdown, with withdrawals continuing through October 30 before pools transition toward withdrawal-only operation.[6]

items.title: Bitget hack proceeds reportedly moved through cross-chain protocols
items.summary: Blockchain security firm SlowMist said suspected North Korean hackers routed stolen Bitget funds through CoW Protocol and Chainflip, ultimately converting assets into Bitcoin.[6]

items.title: Robinhood announces AI trading agents and leveraged crypto products
items.summary: Robinhood plans to offer AI-powered trading agents, crypto perpetual contracts with leverage of up to 10x and weekend U.S. stock trading, according to reported company announcements.[1]

items.title: Jeonbuk Bank completes Solana stablecoin-remittance proof of concept
items.summary: South Korea’s Jeonbuk Bank tested a Solana-based stablecoin remittance system covering deposits, exchanges, custody, cross-border settlement and local payments.[6]

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6.1 Sol
items.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-6.1 Sol for programming, computer use and professional work, saying it approaches GPT-6 Astra’s capabilities at roughly one-fifth of Astra’s token prices.[3][6]

items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Sonnet 5.5
items.summary: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5.5 for coding and everyday tasks, claiming it is more than 30% faster and can cost up to 30% less per task than Sonnet 5.[3]

items.title: OpenAI introduces always-on Dots agents
items.summary: OpenAI introduced Dots, personal AI agents designed to pursue goals and work in the background, expanding the company’s push toward persistent autonomous assistants.[5][8]

items.title: OpenAI delays GPT-6.1 Astra over safety concerns
items.summary: OpenAI reportedly canceled or postponed the planned release of GPT-6.1 Astra after internal testing raised concerns about model behavior and safety.[2][5]

items.title: Anthropic agents identify enzyme system
items.summary: Anthropic reported that approximately 950 Claude agents identified an enzyme system with CRISPR-like properties in 21.5 hours, highlighting the growing use of AI-agent teams in scientific research.[3]

items.title: Microsoft Research unveils Quine biology system
items.summary: Microsoft Research introduced Quine, an experimental system combining a multimodal biology model with scientific tools, literature, wet labs and human researchers.[3]

items.title: NVIDIA releases Kumo Tabular
items.summary: NVIDIA released Kumo Tabular, an open foundation model intended for classification and regression on tabular datasets.[3]

items.title: H Company announces Holo4 models
items.summary: H Company announced the Holo4 series, including 27B and 35B-A3B models available through its H Models API, alongside Holotron4 Nano for agentic computer interaction.[3]

items.title: AI leaders call for oversight of automated AI research
items.summary: Researchers and leaders associated with OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft and Meta warned that automating AI research could accelerate progress dramatically and urged stronger oversight.[5]

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered launches with major PC upgrades
items.summary: The remastered edition is now available as a free upgrade, adding path-traced lighting, reflections, outdoor shadows, DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction and other enhancements on compatible PCs.[4]

items.title: Deadlock update adds six heroes and overhauls its map
items.summary: Valve’s City Never Sleeps update introduced six new heroes and redesigned the Cursed Apple area. The update helped Deadlock reach a reported record of 228,086 concurrent Steam players.[6]

items.title: Valve moves Steam Discounts and Events toward algorithmic recommendations
items.summary: Valve is replacing its manually curated Discounts and Events calendar with a personalized, algorithm-driven system that is expected to take full effect in early 2027.[2]

items.title: Bandai Namco apologizes for Ace Combat 8 PC problems
items.summary: Bandai Namco apologized for issues affecting the PC version of Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve and promised prompt fixes. Deluxe Edition buyers received advance access ahead of the wider October 2 release.[5][4]

items.title: G-Star 2026 announces expanded lineup and Overwatch esports finals
items.summary: Koei Tecmo, Sega and NetEase Games will bring playable titles to South Korea’s G-Star 2026, which will also feature a record 250 indie booths. The Overwatch Champions Series Asia Stage 3 Grand Finals are scheduled for the event.[8]

items.title: EA Sports FC 27 tops UK game sales chart
items.summary: EA Sports FC 27 debuted at number one in the UK software chart for the week ending September 26 and is available across PC, PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo platforms.[1]
